title: $2500 Trading Challenge - 3 days left to sign-up
author: Fynca
selftext:
Hey traders, after so much love from the users who compete the first challenge, we decided to make it a monthly event, and this time the prize pool is up to $2500.

No real money is traded, just your research, strategy, and execution. We are also doing 1-on-1 demo meetings to explain the system or discuss any considerations.

Thanks for the support. See you in the challenge!
